environment.raw_output: JSONL; original byte hashes and full callback histories retained
environment.main_scan_options: all parsers, all-match, metadata, heuristics; clean-result cache disabled equally
environment.cache_diagnostic_options: same except metadata off and clean-result cache enabled equally; not a shipping evidence policy
environment.page_cache_control: fsync + POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED or complete read, verified with mincore at 0% or 100%; no global drop_caches
environment.memory: RSS high water and sampled RSS/PSS/USS; working-set page residency recorded separately; no additive total with shared cgroup
environment.timing: native process; engine startup and integrity-preserving scan pipeline timed; memory snapshots outside timed scan intervals

confidence_method: 95% percentile bootstrap, 4,000 resamples of fresh-process summaries; repeated warm scans averaged within each process
